profile_text.body:
Equifax Inc is a public company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, trading under the ticker EFX. According to its website, it operates as a credit bureau, providing credit reports and credit scores to both businesses and consumers. The site also describes identity protection tools with daily monitoring and alerts, including a product called Equifax Complete, and says the company offers ID Restoration Specialists who work on a customer's behalf to help recover from identity theft. Its site content covers consumer education on credit reports, credit scores, debt, credit cards, loans, and fraud, with material also available in Spanish.

The site's stated focus is on monitoring Equifax credit reports, sending alerts, and helping customers recover from identity theft. The company describes its purpose in terms of helping people understand how financial behavior affects credit and protecting their information.

The company's record shows no tracked AI products and no MCP servers. It is recorded as facing 105 lawsuits in Georgia.
